cohort: A 27-year-old primigravida, 20 weeks gestation, diagnosed with massive condyloma acuminata.
finding: Cauterization of massive condyloma acuminata in a 20-week pregnant primigravida led to clinical recovery, and the pregnancy was safely terminated by cesarean section at 37 weeks.
mod_finding: The pregnancy was terminated by cesarean section at 37 weeks gestation.
